title: Merchant Credits on Single-Use Cards: Points of Judgement — Pocketwire Visa Debit Card
content:
**Rule.** This rule covers the Pocketwire Visa Debit Card. On a purchase made with a single-use virtual card and disputed as an incorrect amount, the merchant credits counted are determined as follows:

- where the card carries merchant credits and none of them is linked to the purchase, every merchant credit on the card is counted;
- where it carries both linked and unlinked merchant credits, the linked credits and the most recent unlinked credit are counted;
- in every other case, only the merchant credits linked to the purchase are counted.

A merchant credit is *linked* when the network ties it to the purchase it refunds. It is *unlinked* when the credit carries no such link. The most recent unlinked credit is the unlinked credit with the latest posting date.

### Truth table

| Linked credits on the card | Unlinked credits on the card | Merchant credits counted |
|---|---|---|
| none | none | none, so 0.00 |
| none | one or more | every merchant credit on the card |
| one or more | none | the linked credits |
| one or more | one or more | the linked credits, plus the most recent unlinked credit |

### Illustrations (hypothetical credits)

- A linked credit of 5.00 and unlinked credits of 3.00, posted on 10 June, and 4.00, posted on 14 June. The count is 5.00 plus 4.00, which is 9.00.
- Unlinked credits of 3.00 and 4.00, with no linked credit. Every credit on the card counts: 7.00.
- A linked credit of 5.00 and nothing else. The count is 5.00.
